step_a: Read the gray comb and container, insert the comb, push obstructed stacks upward by the minimum overlap and clip overflow.
intermediate: The inserted apparatus with the surviving colored cells and their per-lane counts after clipping.
step_b: Recolor the longest surviving colored lane blue, breaking ties leftmost.
why_b_depends_on_a: A taller input stack can lose more cells to a higher tooth; the largest source stack need not be the largest survivor. Ranking before the push selects a different lane.
